text: 金十数据8月20日讯，德国联邦统计局表示，受中间产品和能源成本上涨的推动，德国7月生产者价格涨幅创三年多来新高，显示通胀压力正在重新升温。制造商对食品、工业产品等商品收取的价格同比上涨3.0%，高于分析师预计的2.7%。这是生产者价格自2023年4月以来的最大涨幅，也较6月1.8%的涨幅明显加快。德国7月生产者价格环比上涨1.1%。德国贝特曼银行首席经济学家亚历山大·克鲁格表示：“通胀飙升初期阶段的情况突然变得令人担忧。伊朗战争的影响正在显现，高温天气的影响也同样如此。”莱茵河水位持续数周处于历史低位，阻碍了德国这条最重要的内河航道的航运，导致运输成本上
text_en: Jin Shi Data Aug 20 - Germany's Federal Statistical Office said Germany's July producer price growth hit a three-year high, driven by rising intermediate goods and energy costs, signaling that inflation pressures are re-emerging. Prices charged by manufacturers for food, industrial products and other goods rose 3.0% year-on-year, above the 2.7% analysts expected. This is the largest producer price increase since April 2023 and a clear acceleration from June's 1.8% rise. German producer prices rose 1.1% month-on-month in July. Alexander Krueger, chief economist at Germany's Bethmann Bank, said: "The situation at the early stage of the inflation surge is suddenly becoming concerning. The impact of the Iran war is showing, and so is the impact of the heatwave." The Rhine River's water level has remained at historic lows for weeks, hampering shipping on Germany's most important inland waterway and pushing up transport costs.
